unit_rules.name: The Wolf
unit_rules.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack against an enemy unit that is within Melee Distance of one or more other friendly +Shattered Legions+ units, you can re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. In addition, while this model is within Melee Distance of an enemy unit, friendly +Shattered Legions+ units wholly within 6" can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 in melee.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Wolf
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit and not a +Leader+, this model has +Lone Operative+.
